name: LG Energy Solution-Honda EV Battery Plant (L-H Battery Co.) - Jeffersonville OH

fieldNotes._status: Facility is a brand-new EV battery cell plant still under construction in available satellite imagery (winter/snowy Maxar capture). Per news the plant was 'nearly complete' as of Feb 2026; final truck-yard infrastructure - gates, guard booth, dock build-out, trailer lots - is not yet fully formed or is obscured by snow and construction laydown. Most operational fields are best-effort inference and flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.truckGate: A $3.5B EV cell plant with controlled-access security; the property is set behind a roundabout main entrance off the access road and ringed by buffer land. A controlled truck gate is expected but the specific structure is not resolvable in construction-phase imagery.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Assumed present on facility-class grounds (high-security battery plant); not directly imaged - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: An east-facing building wing with a dock apron and a few trailers is visible; door count obscured by snow - ~35 is a rough mid-band estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Limited trailer parking visible; much of the open ground is construction laydown, not a settled drop yard.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur identified entering the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - Jefferson Township, Fayette County, OH; farmland and small residential clusters; ~40 mi SW of Columbus, just south of I-71.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box covers the core fenced plant property; ~290 acres derived from the box. The full announced site is larger (~78 football fields of building plus grounds); figure is approximate.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single primary battery building with a connected utility/support wing - treated as one facility cluster.
fieldNotes._revisit: Recommend re-audit once non-winter, post-construction imagery is available to confirm gate, guard booth, dock count and trailer yard.
